meta.name: antinet-provenance
meta.description: 收集系统全链路操作日志，生成可追溯的执行证据链与向量索引，是多智能体系统可观测性与安全审计的底座。

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 追踪多智能体系统全链路操作，生成可追溯证据链
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果在构建多智能体系统时，需要记录操作日志并满足审计需求
copy.tagline_en: Track full-chain operations in multi-agent systems and generate traceable evidence chains
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you build multi-agent systems that need operation logs and audit trails

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会记录系统中的每一步操作事件，按 trace_id 串成可追溯的证据链，并生成向量索引；还能按条件检索历史证据。失败时先缓存，恢复后再补写。
howto.when: 当系统在关键操作节点（如分发、扫描、解析等）被调用，或通过事件总线异步推送事件时触发。

say.text: 记录这次分发操作，写入证据链
say.note: 会生成带 trace_id 的事件记录

say.text: 按 trace_id 查询这个任务的历史证据
say.note: 返回该链路下的全部操作记录

say.text: 检索今天所有解析事件
say.note: 按时间窗返回历史事件与向量索引条目

howto.what_en: Claude records each operation event, links them into a traceable evidence chain per trace_id, and creates a vector index. It can query historical evidence by filters; failed writes are cached locally and retried.
howto.when_en: Triggers when a key operation node (e.g., dispatch, scan, parse) is called, or when an event is pushed via the event bus.

say_en.text: Record this dispatch operation and write it to the evidence chain.
Query the historical evidence for this task by trace_id.
say_en.note: Returns the full chain for that trace.

say_en.text: Search all parsing events from today.
say_en.note: Returns time-filtered history and vector entries.
